args.body: the metabolism is read and routed: 0 requirement(s) for physics_check, 1 for performance_check, 0 that no layer takes. Where the words went before was nowhere: the clause came back unparsed and the request to EAT CARBON, which is the entire design, reached no check at all.

performance_criteria.how: performance_check { kind: "mass_balance", ... } -- the quantities it needs are the designer's to declare, with sources

routing.structures: organism-design/blueprint.mjs reads the structures named in the text and resolves them to Uberon/CL terms for the taxon; organism_from_blueprint brings the result into the studio
routing.laws: lean_check decides clade scope from the taxon and reports every law as holds / violated / out-of-scope / cannot-evaluate
routing.movement: locomotion_check -- how it moves, which no part list can settle: the scallop theorem, the cycle arithmetic and the Reynolds/Froude regimes
routing.world: ecology_check -- where the clade is recorded, what else is there, and what is recorded eating it. It will not predict exclusion without declared population parameters.

result.scope: A co-design log. Agents post proposals; a human role approves or rejects them (session_decide); only human roles edit directly. Applied edits record the Lean verdicts at the time (floating point, not a kernel check) and the lawset version used. Authors are role labels, not people.
